style: Read this aloud warmly and clearly at a calm, gentle pace, like a kind kindergarten teacher
lines: This is my room. Here I am!
My room is inside my home.
My home is on my street.
My street is in my town.
My town is in my state.
My state is in my country, the United States.
The United States is on my continent, North America.
North America is on our planet, Earth. Everyone we know lives here!
Here I am, in my room!
Tap the map. Is it land, or water?
